description: Holds the two channels of control voltage a MemoryCV ensemble records into and plays from, sampled at 1000Hz; it is always the left-most module of the group, and alone it neither records nor plays

params.text: Pressing it sets every sample in the buffer to 0V and leaves its length alone
Sets the length of the buffer in seconds, 1 to 1000, taking effect at the next press of RESET
Pressing it discards the buffer, builds a new one of LENGTH seconds, and fills it with 0V

inputs.text: A trigger sets every sample in the buffer to 0V and leaves its length alone
Takes a Tipsy text message naming a WAV or CSV file to load, relative to the load folder picked in the menu; a message of a hash and a number loads the file at that place in the folder instead
Takes a Tipsy text message naming a WAV or CSV file to write the buffer to, relative to the save folder picked in the menu; an existing file of that name is overwritten with no prompt

outputs.text: A trigger each time a file load finishes, whether it succeeded or failed
A trigger each time a file save finishes, whether it succeeded or failed
Tipsy text describing each load and save, including the length of a file read in, for a TEXT input on TTY
A steady voltage equal to the number of seconds in the buffer, so a buffer of 15 seconds gives 15V

notes: by itself it neither records nor plays: put a Brainwash or an Embellish to write into it, and a Ruminate or a Fixation to play it, touching it on the right
dropping a WAV or CSV file from the desktop onto the panel loads it at once
the buffer is stored at 1000 samples a second whatever the Rack sample rate, and playback does not interpolate between samples, so recorded pitches stay as they were
the display above the LENGTH output shows the buffer length in seconds and hundredths, or in minutes and seconds once it passes 60 seconds
a CSV file loaded here is read as one line per millisecond, each line a left and a right value separated by a comma
anything other than Tipsy text arriving at LOAD or SAVE can crash Rack
menu: Autoload most recent file when this module starts — reads the last file this module loaded when the patch opens or the module is duplicated
Reload most recent file now — loads the last file this module read straight away
Most Recently Used Directories — a submenu of the twenty folders most recently used by any module of this kind, one of which becomes the loading folder
Pick via Directory Selector... — picks the loading folder that names arriving at LOAD are relative to, and appears again under Saving Directory for the SAVE folder
Pick file from Loading directory — a submenu of the WAV and CSV files in the loading folder; choosing one loads it at once
Pick file via dialog... — opens the operating system's file browser and loads the WAV or CSV file chosen
Save to WAV File... — writes the whole buffer to a WAV file named through a dialog
Save to CSV File... — writes the whole buffer to a CSV file of one left and one right value per line, named through a dialog
